answer_text: Geo Restriction in IPS is based on IP geolocation, not domains, so adding the partner's domain to an IPS allowlist will not bypass a Brazil block. To allow them, create an IPS allowlist rule with the partner’s IP ranges in the Destination field, or define an inbound/outbound IPS Geo Restriction rule for Brazil. Note that IPS Geo Restriction rules are not applied to traffic from Cato SDP Clients; if the partner traffic comes from a SDP client, you must adjust the Client Connectivity Policy to allow Brazil instead.
